_comment: EXAMPLE provisioning config — PLACEHOLDERS ONLY. Copy to provision.config.json (GIT-IGNORED) and fill in your APPROVED non-production test-site values at runtime. NEVER commit real values: no real site URL, tenant ID, client ID, secret, or user-specific identifier belongs in git. Safe defaults below are intentionally fail-closed (phase2Approved=false) so the example cannot provision anything as-is.
operatorNotes: Set phase2Approved=true and replace siteReferencePlaceholder with the approved non-production test-site reference in your git-ignored provision.config.json. Do not point at legacy or production. No Power Automate flows are created. No writeback to legacy.
